scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/worker
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm test -w apps/web && npm test -w apps/worker
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/worker
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > apps/web/src/server/db/database.types.ts
